description: Netlife Craft CMS update policy. Sites extend this with one line.

packageRules.description: Patch updates, one PR a week. Automerge is switched on after the first grouped PR has been merged by hand.
Minor updates, one PR a month, always merged by a developer.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Majors are project work, never automated.
Vulnerability fixes open immediately. Patch-level fixes automerge once automerge is on.
